capability_boundary: registryRead potentially grants reads to every registry object carrying this capability ACE, not only the two catalog roots. It is not the InternetClient or PNCS well-known capability, and this observation does not prove network authorization or isolation.
facts: Microsoft 10107 is WSASYSCALLFAILURE generic system-call failure, not 10106 provider-failed-init.
Both observed Winsock catalog root DACLs contain registryRead ReadKey and AAP ReadKey, with no ARAP or tested lpacNetwork/lpacNetworking ACE.
Both observed system DLL DACLs contain ARAP ReadAndExecute.
The listed Chromium policy setup adds registryRead before type-specific capabilities; the named-capability implementation matches the actual local derivation.
hypothesis: A zero-cap LPAC may be unable to read catalog registry objects and thereby fail Winsock initialization. No effective-access check or failing-call trace was performed; 10107 does not identify a unique cause.
